c1-a.title: Blazing Assault
c1-a.description: Gain the ability to use the fifth strike of a swift attack.

c1-b.title: Howling Blade
c1-b.description:
Potent Blow during a swift attack. dodge swift attack, or Blowback: Vengeance.

Activate a potent blow during a swift attack to deliver a chain of attacks.

The form of Howling Blade activated will vary depending on the level of the swift attack.

After activation. press Swift Attack to chain into a swift attack of the next level.
c1-b.requirements: Requires Blazing Assault, Requires Mastery Level 2

c1-c.title: Whirlwind
c1-c.description:
Press Potent Blow during swift attack, dodge swift attack, or Blowback: Vengeance.

Leaps up and attacks nearby enemies.

Pressing Potent Blow again after the upward attack chains into a downward attack.
c1-c.requirements: Requires Blazing Assault, Requires Mastery Level 2

c1-d.title: Howling Blade: Punishment
c1-d.description:
Potent Blow after the fourth strike of a swift attack or after Blazing Assault.

Gain the ability to use a finishing blow after the fourth strike of a swift attack and after Blazing Assault.

The finishing blow consists of a dash followed by consecutive slashes. Press Potent Blow before the dash ends to chain into the consecutive slashes.
c1-d.requirements: Requires Mastery Level 10 and Howling Blade

c1-e.title: Whirlwind: Swiftness
c1-e.description: Increase the attack speed of Whirlwind.

c1-f.title: Howling Blade: Resolve
c1-f.description:
Potent Blow after the fourth strike of a swift attack or after Blazing Assault.

Gain the ability to use a finishing blow after the fourth strike of a swift attack and after Blazing Assault.

The finishing blow consists of a dash followed by consecutive slashes. Press Potent Blow before the dash ends to chain into the consecutive slashes.
c1-f.requirements: Requires Mastery Level 18 and Howling Blade: Punishment

c1-g.title: Phantom: Sword Dance
c1-g.description:
Command: Ranged Attack/Skill Combination Key + Potent Blow

Resources Used: Spirit 2

Attack the enemy with the Phantom's power.

For 40 seconds after using Phantom: Sword Dance. the Phantom will rush forward to attack alongside you when using Howling Blade or Whirlwind.

c1-h.title: Whirlwind: Chain
c1-h.description:
Press Potent Blow after the downward attack from Whirlwind.

Gain the ability to use a follow-up dash attack after the downward attack.
c1-h.requirements: Requires Mastery Level 18 and Whirlwind: Swiftness

c2-a.title: Massive Blow
c2-a.description:
Press Potent Blow after the third attack of a potent blow or the charged attack of a potent blow.

 Charge forward and attack after the final attack of a potent blow.

The damage of this skill increases when used after a fully charged potent blow.

This skill can also be chained after the final attack of potent blow-type attacks.

c2-b.title: Dragon Slayer
c2-b.description:
Hold Potent Blow

Charged potent blows become dash attacks.

c2-c.title: Gale
c2-c.description:
Hold Potent Blow 

Charged potent blows inflict the Injured status on ememies.

Gain the virgor effect every time an Unjured enemy takes damage.

While under this effect, damage dealt increases with each stack, up to a maximum of 10 stacks.

c2-d.title: Dragon Slayer: Intuition
c2-d.description:
Hold Potent Blow after Dragon Slayer.

Pressing Potent Blow again after using Dragon Slayer results in a double slash attack on the enemy.
c2-d.requirements: Requires Mastery Level 10 and Dragon Slayer

c2-e.title: Gale: Scar
c2-e.description:
Detonate accumulated vigor to deal significant damage to enemies.

Activate Gale: Scar and remove all vigor effects when striking an enemy with Gale while at 10 vigor stacks.

c2-f.title: Dragon Slayer: Chain
c2-f.description:
Press Potent Blow after Dragon Slayer: Intuition. 

Press Potent Blow again after using Dragon Slayer: Intuition to leap into the air with an attack.

Pressing Potent Blow again during the upward attack triggers a downward attack.
c2-f.requirements: Requires Mastery Level 18 and Dragon Slayer: Intuition

c2-h.title: Gale: Smash
c2-h.description:
Resources Used: Spirit 2

Hold Potent Blow when landing a strike with Gale.

Detonate vigor inside the enemy.

Poise increases significantly during this attack. 

Each detonation of vigor grants additional stacks of vigo
c2-h.requirements: Requires Mastery Level 18 and Gale: Scar

c3-a.title: Wind Chaser
c3-a.description:
Press Swift Attack or Potent Blow after spirit attack.

Gain the ability to use the second attack of a sprint attack.

c3-b.title: Outrage
c3-b.description:
Potent Blow while spirnting

Deliver a powerful strike while sprinting.

Charging the attack increases the amount of stagger and damage inflicted.

c3-c.title: Ruthless
c3-c.description:
Command: Skill Combination Key + Swift Attack

 Resources Used: Spirit 1

Swiftly hack apart the enemy. After a successful strike. each successive input results in a flurry of attacks that increases in speed and consumes stamina.

Stopping the input or running out of stamina will automatically result in a finishing blow.

Deliver a powerful finishing blow when the attack speed reaches its maximum.

c3-d.title: Wind Chaser: Swift
c3-d.description:
Potent Blow after a spirit attack

Swiftly chains with a potent blow after a spirit atack.
c3-d.requirements: Requires Mastery Level 2 and Wind Chaser

c3-e.title: Breeze Dash
c3-e.description:
Command: Skill Combination Key + Swift Attack

Resources Used: Spirit 1

Swiftly dash forward and slash the enemy.

The dash slash can be used up to 2 times and nullifies the damage from enemy attacks when it starts. 

Each dash slash consumes i spirit charge

c3-f.title: Wind Piercer
c3-f.description:
Press Potent Blow after Dragon Slayer: Intuition. 

Press Potent Blow again after using Dragon Slayer: Intuition to leap into the air with an attack.

Pressing Potent Blow again during the upward attack triggers a downward attack.
c3-f.requirements: Requires Mastery Level 18 and Dragon Slayer: Intuition

c3-g.title: Ruthless: Stamina
c3-g.description:
The finishing blow of Ruthless is transformed into an arcing strike.

Recover half of the stamina consumed if the strike hits an enemy.

c3-h.title: Wind Piercer: Persistence
c3-h.description:
Press Potent Blow after Dragon Slayer: Intuition. 

Press Potent Blow again after using Dragon Slayer: Intuition to leap into the air with an attack.

Pressing Potent Blow again during the upward attack triggers a downward attack.
c3-h.requirements: Requires Mastery Level 18 and Dragon Slayer: Intuition

c3-i.title: Breeze Dash: Chain
c3-i.description: The dash slashes of Breeze Dash deliver multiple strikes to enemies whose damage was nullified.
c3-i.requirements: Requires Mastery Level 26 and Breeze Dash

c3-j.title: Ruthless: Strength
c3-j.requirements: Requires Mastery Level 34 and Ruthless: Stamina

c3-k.title: Wind Piercer: Mark
c3-k.description:
Press Potent Blow after Dragon Slayer: Intuition. 

Press Potent Blow again after using Dragon Slayer: Intuition to leap into the air with an attack.

Pressing Potent Blow again during the upward attack triggers a downward attack.
c3-k.requirements: Requires Mastery Level 18 and Dragon Slayer: Intuition

c3-l.title: Breeze Dash: Triple
c3-l.description: Allows for up to three dash slashes with Breeze Dash.
c3-l.requirements: requires Mastery Level 34 and Breeze Dash: Chain

c4-a.title: Nimble Blitz
c4-a.description:
Swift Attack/Fire Ranged Attack while dodging

Enhance the attack that results from activating swift attack while dodging.

Forward and lateral attacks become a forward dash followed by two consecutive strikes. 

Backward attacks become a backward dash followed by a strike that releases a shockwave.

c4-b.title: Fleet Footed
c4-b.description: Decrease the stamina cost of dodging.

c4-c.title: Agressive Action
c4-c.description:
Potent Blow during dodge

Enhance the attack that results from activating potent blow while dodging.

Hold Potent Blow to activate a charged version of this skill.

c4-d.title: Deftness
c4-d.description:
Move forward + Dodge while attacking

Dodging forward while attacking results in a dodge-attack.

c4-e.title: Gust
c4-e.description:
Command: Assing Input

Resources Used: Spirit 1

Take a powerful swing at the enemy with your axe and sword.

c4-f.title: Cold Blood: Stamina
c4-f.description: Recover stamina upon performing a brink dodge.

c4-g.title: Disciplined Action
c4-g.description: The invincibility duration of dodges increases in proportion to your agility.

c4-h.title: Deftness: Lightfoot
c4-h.description: Increase the distance traveled when dodging and increase the damage of Deftness.

c4-i.title: Gust: Strength
c4-i.description:
Nullify damage from enemy attacks when activating Gust.

Nullifying damage using Gust restores the spirit consumed by Gust over the course of a few seconds.

c4-j.title: Cold Blood: Spirit
c4-j.description: Gain spirit upon performing a brink dodge
c4-j.requirements: requires Mastery Level 18 and Cold Blood: Stamina

c4-k.title: Zephyr
c4-k.description:
Command: Assing Input

Resources Used: Spirit 1

Skirt around the enemy to attack.

Move left or right using the directional buttons. You will move right if there is no directional input.

c4-l.title: Gust: Stream
c4-l.description:
Repeat input after Gust.

Deliver a powerful upward slash.

 Activate by repeating the input while Gust is active.

Consume 1 additional spirit charge upon use.
c4-l.requirements: Requires Mastery Level 26 and Gust: Strength

c4-m.title: Disciplined Action: Agility
c4-m.description: Increase the invincibility duration of dodges.
c4-m.requirements: Requires Mastery Level 26 and Disciplined Action

c4-n.title: Wind Slash Step
c4-n.description:
Resources Used: Spirit 1

Swift Attack while downed or taking damage. 

React swiftly to danger in critical moments.

Use Wind Slash Step with Swift Attack while downed to quickly regain your stance and attack nearby enemies with a flurry of blades. 

Use Wind Slash Step with Swift Attack while taking damage to land a strike where you stand and dash through enemies to break away from your position.

c5-a.title: Blowback
c5-a.description: Deal damage to enemies when performing a brink guard.

c5-b.title: Ironclad
c5-b.description: Decrease the amount of stamina consumed on a successful guard.

c5-c.title: Blowback: Vengeance
c5-c.description:
Press Swift Attack/Fire Ranged Attack after a successful Blowback

Swiftly counterstrikes after a successful Blowback.

If Howling Blade or Whirlwind are equipped. you can chain them by pressing Potent Blow

c5-d.title: Reversal
c5-d.description:
Neutral or Back + Dodge/Sprint after a successful guard.

Dodging backward after a successful guard results in a dodge-attack.

c5-e.title: Flash Cutter
c5-e.description:
Command: Ranged Skill Combination Key + Potent Blow

Resources Used: Spirit 1

Rush toward an enemy and deliver a swift strike. 

Nullify incoming damage and activate a counterstrike when attacked during the initial activation of Flash Cutter.

You can launch the attack at any time by releasing the input while the skill is charging.

c5-f.title: Reversal: Assault
c5-f.description:
Allows Reversal to be charged.

Charging the skill launches shockwaves. allowing you to hit enemies farther away.

Learning Reversal: Assault allows Reversal to be chained after Blowback: Vengeance. and Reversal will always launch shockwaves when used in this way.

c5-g.title: Reversal: Flow
c5-g.description: Neutral or Back + Dodge/Sprint during a normal attack.  Gain the ability to chain into Reversal at any time during a normal attack
c5-g.requirements: Requires Mastery Level 26 and Reversal: Assault

c5-h.title: Flash Cutter: Counter
c5-h.description:
Nullify incoming damage during Flash Cutter's attack and break the enemy's stance.

Flash Cutter's damage increases when breaking the enemy's stance.
c5-h.requirements: Requires Mastery Level 26 and Flash Cutter

c5-i.title: Flash Cutter: Decollation
c5-i.description: Deliver a follow-up strike after Flash Cutter when striking an exhausted enemy.
c5-i.requirements: Requires astery Level 34 and Flash Cutter: Counter

gs0-a.title: Savage Momentum
gs0-a.description: Unleash a shockwave along with a powerful strike to attack enemies in a wide area.

gs0-b.title: Ground Breaker
gs0-b.description: Swift attacks have a 20% chance to create a shockwave that deals additional damage to nearby enemies.

gs0-c.title: Overwhelming Force
gs0-c.description: Increases the damage of swift attacks by 5% for each enemy within 5 meters, up to 25%.

gs0-d.title: Seismic Impact
gs0-d.description: Strike the ground with tremendous force, stunning enemies within 8 meters for 3 seconds.
